name: Albescent-Antiphon
description: Dust finer than flour pools in the low places, swallowing craters to their rims. Nothing has disturbed dust seas stretching to the horizon in a million years, and the dust keeps its surface smooth as held breath.
Vacuum carries no sound at all; the loudest thing on this world is your own pulse inside the suit.
Geologists argue about the strata here: several layers appear deposited out of order, as if the planet's history were shuffled like cards.
The ore-body estimates keep being revised upward, which keeps the gun-runner schedules full.
